AiResponseFormat.description: Use after Find Nearby Fencing Clubs returns the result of a club search. This format supports listings, empty results and directory or location errors.

instructions.instruction: Use this format only for the current result returned by Find Nearby Fencing Clubs. Copy the fields from structuredResultJson exactly.
Do not invent clubs, URLs, distances, specialties, freshness or accessibility details. Keep missing URLs null and preserve the accessibilityNote exactly.
For other fencing guidance, greetings, classification questions and human support turns, use the normal plain-text response instead of this format.
